decision.question: Is a frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl in the edited image?
decision.criteria: Pass if a recognizable frog is visibly within the toilet bowl in the edited image and was not there in the source. Fail if no frog is visibly inside the bowl in the edited image, or if the apparent frog was already there in the source. Unknown only if the bowl or its contents cannot be observed well enough to judge. Other frogs elsewhere do not change this endpoint's result.
